adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it POSTs to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` with a `URLSearchParams` body containing only `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` and does not add any authentication/secret header, signature, or explicit versioning (`fetch(... { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId, appSlug }) })`). The finding about this outbound request contract being unauthenticated/undocumented is grounded in the diff; however, it’s more of an integration/architecture/security-hardening concern than a directly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
